sentences.text:
Petitioner :- Riyaz Ahmad
Respondent :- State Of U.P.Thru Prin.Secy.Food & Civil Supplies Lko & Ors.
Counsel for Petitioner :- Sheikh Mohammad Ali

Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Pankaj Mithal,J.
Hon'ble Saurabh Lavania,J.
The petitioner, by means of this petition, wants that a direction be issued to respondent no.2/Designated Officer, Department of Food Safety of the District to issue licence in his favour for selling buffalo meat and that respondent no.3/District Magistrate be restrained from interfering in his selling buffalo meat till licence is obtained and for obtaining licence.

Learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel, Sri A.N. Trivedi, submitted that for the licence to sell the buffalo meat the petitioner has to apply in accordance with Section 31 of the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006 and regulations framed there under.

We do not find that the petitioner has made any application to respondent no.2/Designated Officer,
Department of Food Safety of the District in the prescribed form for obtaining such licence by depositing requisite fee.
